scope: read-only JSON reduction; no rerun, no production admission, no overall pass

near_zero.source_scope: only original-tolerance mismatches in fixed diagnostic timing random CC cases; independent 200-digit arithmetic and fsum; no changed tolerances or production behavior

limitations: Original timing.json has methodology defects and is retained only as historical diagnostic, not same-CPU evidence.
Controlled timings are 12 paired rounds in one persistent process, not 12 independent processes; all raw samples retained and no significance inference made.

Timing includes independent output allocation and ABI calls, retaining the prior result, but no Scheduler/AST/DAG/guard/process transport; NJIT TLS policy set/restore is outside measured call, BLAS wrapper policy is inside.
Endpoint thread counts and configured/restored library policies do not prove peak transient worker counts or hardware affinity.
Heap outputs preallocated before epoch; kernel workspace only. RSS, stack, complete-request and NJIT heap not measured here.
Timing and heap have equal geometries but different fixed seeds; their numeric mismatch totals must not be merged as one input population.
Allocation counts/traffic are diagnostics, not independent adoption vetoes; actual extra live/peak bytes remain real measured costs.
Projected Boolean checks are NumPy checks, not actual downstream AST/DAG branch/status acceptance; public graph boundary remains unclosed.
Bitwise differences are observations, not an added all-float contract. Original tolerance and IEEE discrepancies are retained.
Selected near-zero high-precision diagnostics cannot prove either implementation globally correct or authorize tolerance changes.
